decision: Treat raw ZIP, raw chat JSON, Architectura historical conversation, and its reference copy as PRIVATE_LOCAL.
reason: Public-repository privacy hard gate and archived-role content.

decision: Do not edit production until all Round 0 baseline evidence is written.
Use the 43 districts of Provincia de Lima as the fail-closed candidate, ranking and route boundary.
rationale: The user explicitly limited the work to Lima Metropolitana and named Lima Province districts; INEI identifies Lima Metropolitana under Ley 31140 as the 43 districts of Provincia de Lima.
effects: Callao and all other locations remain pedagogy-only or quarantined
Historical neighborhood and cross-district labels require explicit aliases
No geographic fame or proximity bonus is introduced

decision: Treat the reconciled 81 Master82 candidates as historical-only and non-rankable.
rationale: Semantic deduplication establishes identity, but current-source, access, ethics and one-frame verification have not yet been completed.
effects: UV3 historical IDs merge without losing provenance
Historical scores/ranks are excluded from canonical records
No new Master label is claimed

decision: Omit legal and photography-permission research from the architecture workstream; retain only practical open/closed, schedule and essential contact checks.
rationale: The user explicitly rejected legal considerations as irrelevant and directed their omission.
effects: No legal permission ledger or legal-warning UI
Scene research focuses on visual evidence, learning, ranking, routing and integration
Operational access remains a route-safety/currentity input
Existing general ethics requirements remain concise and non-legal

decision: Register every current primary URL in verification cohort VERIFY-2026-08-27-A exactly once in the canonical public source registry without promoting any candidate.
rationale: Production dossiers require stable source IDs and provenance, while source existence alone is insufficient evidence for ranking or routing.
effects: Nine cohort sources added to data/architecture/sources.json
All six cohort candidates resolve their current URLs
Historical ranks remain excluded

decision: Integrate Arquitectura en Foco through the existing dependency-free generator and dual-release architecture rather than introducing React, Motion or XYFlow in this slice.
rationale: The current product is a static generator with standalone and PWA targets; a framework migration would add offline, Safari, bundle and parity risk before scene/ranking data is mature. Native HTML/CSS/JS supplies the required pedagogy and field interaction now.
effects: Home navigation discovers the Challenge
Hosted build copies Challenge and public data
PWA core precaches the field shell
Graph visualization remains deferred and must be justified by validated data

decision: Show the six admitted candidates as an unordered verification queue instead of a Top 3 or route recommendation.
rationale: No current ranking model/run or complete scene dossiers exist; presenting ordered priorities would launder historical hypotheses into product truth.
effects: First screen remains actionable through practice and field protocol
No winning-probability or false rank language
Ranking and route UI stay gated

decision: Treat all 81 reconciled canonical identities as the visible equal-depth universe; the six-source cohort is a pilot state only.
rationale: The user requires 40+ places to receive the same context, images, composition analysis and answered questions. Restricting the visible product to six would create unjustified research privilege.
effects: User can show 10, 25, 40 or all 81
Six records show verification started and 75 show equal-depth pending
Public candidates data contains no historical ranks
No robust ranking starts until equal-depth dossiers pass

decision: Use four transparent linear-additive internal preference scenarios, bounded fixed-seed sensitivity ranks and Pareto status instead of one authoritative scalar.
rationale: Authoritative MCDA guidance treats the model as a decision aid, requires normalized preference weights and sensitivity review, and warns that compensatory scores can conceal weak dimensions.
effects: Official criteria remain two explicitly labeled proxies
Historical ranks are prohibited inputs
Small score differences never imply calibrated outcome likelihood
Users can compare R0–R3, rank intervals, Pareto status and evidence confidence

decision: Make field rank balance strategic photographic value with feasibility, access and evidence rather than optimizing convenience alone.
rationale: The first v1.0.1 field formula placed an easy but strategically mid-ranked scene first; an expert field allocator would reject a list that spends scarce shooting time without considering upside.
effects: v1.0.1 remains immutable provenance
v1.1.0 adds creative, thematic and causality value to field weights
Route eligibility remains false until Round 5 time-window evidence passes
